## Expression on this line

Education at orange Stage 11 is the **autonomous-inquiry-and-evidence-based-knowledge institution
subordinated to a rights-equal-procedure regime**: education is the discipline of inquiry
governed by evidence and method, with credentialing flowing from substantive-disciplines of
achievement rather than from social-fit, and with institutional autonomy guaranteed
substantive-statutorily and operative.

The constitutive choice is to organize the educational-institution around **autonomous-
inquiry-and-evidence**: out-group intellectual content is treated on the same procedural
plane as the in-group's preferred lineage; authorities-over-inquiry are gated by evidence
and method, and the application of inquiry is statutorily-protected from political-pressure.
Studying, conducting research, teaching, credentialing, and grading are all governed by
substantive-statute-and-evidence-and-method discipline rather than by transmission-of-in-group-
or-form-of-the-role.

The structural changes are:

- **Institutional-autonomy statute.** Academic-institutions-operate-under-statute, with
  statutory independent-governance and tenure-statute.
- **Academic-freedom statutory protection.** Academic-freedom-statute with peer-judgment-
  discipline and statutory-review protection.
- **Anti-discrimination statute covering education domain.** Anti-discrimination statute
  applied to educational-domain-as-public-service.
- **Examination-integrity statutory-applied.** Examination-statute-system with stare-decisis-
  discipline arms-length-statute-discipline.
- **Statute-research-funding and peer-reviewed-discipline.** Discipline-of-funding-and-publication
  discipline codified-statute-published.
- **Substantive-curriculum-statute-rationale.** Substantive-curriculum-discipline-by-discipline,
  with statutorily-published-rationale-discipline.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from orange-11)

- **UL:** the practitioner's *vocation-as-inquiry-disciplinary-discipline-from-political-
  press*: teacher, scholar, researcher whose work-craft operates independent of group-political-
  pressure.
- **UR:** autonomous institutions, independent-regulatory regime on academic-grade-discipline,
  academic-freedom statute protection.
- **LL:** *civic-faith-in-inquiry-discipline*: a polity that recognizes inquiry as a public-
  domain bound by discipline-of-evidence-and-method rather than as a service-of-transmission-
  of-in-group.
- **LR:** academic-freedom statute, autonomy statute, anti-discrimination statute applied,
  examination-disciplines statute-applied, substantive-curriculum-disciplines statute-publish.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to orange-11):** **credentialist-disciplinary-discipline** — over-
  reliance on credential-statistical-discipline-of-published-statutes substitutes for the
  substantive-immersion in the work-of-inquiry discipline; credential-statistical denial-of-
  right-of-action becomes its own loyalty-network.
- **Dark allergy (orange-11 foundation skipped/fragile):** statute-of-academic-freedom on the
  statute-book with tradition-of-discipline-of-political-press, academic-institutions-statute
  in form with profile-of-political-press statutorily visible in audit; recurrent-statistical-
  bias-of-hiring-by-in-group-affiliation visible in published-statutory-statistical.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Green prematurely):** **multi-stakeholder-networked-horizons-and-
  pedagogy-and-networked-classroom** as substitute for academic-discipline-as-public-domain;
  multi-stakeholder-craft-icons-as-substance.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing orange-11):** nativist-refusal of *critical-inquiry-as-
  public-domain bound by rights-equality-procedure*; "we do pedagogy as our way"; refusing the
  worldcentric turn.

the signal as a class; the specific real-world instance lives in the Entity holon that cites
this cell.

- **Academic-freedom statutory-operational.** Statutory-and-effective-track-record-of-academic-

- **Anti-discrimination-statutory-applied.** Coverage-of-anti-discrimination-statute applied to

- **Examination-statute-disciplines-applied.** Examination-discipline arms-length-statute with

- **Substantive-curriculum-statutory-disciplines.** Substantive-curriculum-discipline statutory-

- **Statute-research-funding-applied-discipline.** Statute-research-funding-discipline published-
  peer-review-discipline applied-statute-record.
- **Comparative-discipline engagement statistical.** Engaged-disciplines-statutory-and-published-
  rate with cross-jurisdiction-academic-publication-statistical.
